iron__from__ice_: Walter Ice was a fisherman in Northwick until the posters went up. He came to S-F7 with a pocket Bible with a hole in it, and within a day the whole bay knew that he is superstitious about the number three.
Walter Ice's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Walter Ice found a clean patch on the table and put his bread on it. Someone immediately asked to borrow the patch. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Walter Ice watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Walter Ice had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks crossed it, Walter Ice fired. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks was badly wounded.
ryder_miller11: "You're late," said the corporal when Cyril Miller arrived on Day 4. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
